title: English Practice Quiz 0634
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: I have ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Lost is the past participle of lose.

questions.question: There isn't ___ milk left.
questions.explanation: Milk is uncountable, so use much in a negative sentence.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: By next June, he ___ the course.
questions.explanation: The future perfect describes an action completed before a future time.

questions.question: You need a moment to think. You say:
options: Let me think for a moment.
questions.explanation: This phrase politely signals that you need a little time.

questions.question: Choose the correct WH question for a place.
questions.explanation: Where asks about a place or location.

questions.question: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: The zero conditional uses present simple for general truths.

questions.question: ___ student must bring an ID card.
questions.explanation: Each refers to every individual in a group.

questions.question: The keys are ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On describes something resting on a surface.
